lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to use the hop block and repeat to make characters bounce and celebrate.
Hop jumps up and comes back down in the same place.
Put hop inside a repeat to bounce many times.
Characters can hop when they reach a goal — hooray!
Walk to the star, then hop 3 times to celebrate! Use 🔁.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
